verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a dedicated Sandbox API for exploring all features, with test cards and account details for simulated transactions, including 3DS2 challenge flows and accept/refuse payin simulation. SDKs can be pointed at a preproduction environment (e.g. Ruby's `c.preproduction = true`), keeping testing separate from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox credential and data isolation from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
